description: Exploit on the TON side of the TAC cross-chain bridge, about 2.85 million USD lost (USDT, BLUM, tsTON); about 90 percent of the still-accessible assets were recovered.
price_evidence: Binance perp 1m, 2026-05-11 UTC: open 0.020098, close 0.019866 (-1.2%); the 02:20 UTC minute traded 0.02016 to 0.02019, no visible move. 2026-05-12 UTC: open 0.019862, low 0.016827 at 17:36 (-15.3% vs open), close 0.017958 (-9.6%)
notes: Official post-mortem (dated 2026-05-20, no time shown) gives the incident as about 02:20 UTC on 2026-05-11; other outlets said May 12. TAC's own tweet, archived by web3isgoinggreat, shows 2026-05-13 1:52 PM with no time zone. No usable publish time, so known_at is empty and the row is flagged. The price link to the later May 12 drop is unverified.

description: Exploit in the Cosmos EVM layer drained a bonded TAC supply pool (about 2.99 billion TAC per the forensics cited); the chain was halted at block 24,671,475. TAC says only the TAC token supply was affected.
price_evidence: Binance perp 1m: close 0.002546 at 19:46 UTC, 0.002531 at 19:48, 0.001917 at 19:52 (-24.6% vs the 19:44 close of 0.002541, in 8 minutes)
notes: Start time 19:46:37 and halt block time 23:58:11 UTC are from rekt.news (published 2026-09-01), citing forensics by Rarma; SlowMist valued the drain at about 7.5 million USD; other outlets quote other figures. known_at is CryptoSlate's publish time (2026-08-24 08:50 GMT); TAC's own notice was dated 2026-08-22 with no time shown, so the true public time was earlier and this is a conservative bound.

description: TAC perpetual crashed on 2026-08-22 (Binance and Bybit perps agree) and partly recovered within hours.
price_evidence: Binance perp 1m, 2026-08-22 UTC: open 0.002755, low 0.00104 at 20:20 (-62.3% vs open), close 0.00165 (-40.1%); Bybit perp low 0.001051 at 20:20; the fall began at 19:48 to 19:52 UTC
notes: The fall began minutes after the exploit start time in the row above: a timing match only, not a cause (unverified). See docs/aug_2026_divergence_report.md: CoinGecko and DeFiLlama show about 0.00102 at 2026-08-23 00:00, near this low, and are excluded by the 2 percent rule.
